subject: Kickoff: KeyPose for transparent-object bin picking
body:
Team,

Kicking off the KeyPose track. The product hook: robotic pick cells fail hardest on glassware and clear packaging because depth sensors return garbage on transparent surfaces. KeyPose sidesteps that — stereo RGB in, labeled 3D keypoints out — and our open-source release ships with 600 sequences, roughly 48k stereo and depth images at 720p, across 15 transparent objects in 5 categories. That's our training and eval base.

Milestones (Apr 27 - Jul 20):
- May 29: reproduce released-model keypoint accuracy on the bottle and cup categories
- Jun 26: fine-tuned models on our own 3-object pilot capture from the lab cell
- Jul 15: end-to-end pick demo readout for the partner conversation

Ivo — compute and staffing please, plus whatever the Corpus ingest of the pilot captures needs. I want the data-platform dependency understood in week one, not week ten.

Lucia
